**Answer: Yes.**

**Proof.**

Let $[K:\mathbb{Q}_p]=ef$, with $R$ the ring of integers and $\mathfrak{p}$ the maximal ideal of $R$. Since $v_K(p)=e$, we have $pR=\mathfrak{p}^e$.

For $x\in R$, the norm is $N_{K/\mathbb{Q}_p}(x)=\det(m_x)$, where $m_x:K\to K$ is the $\mathbb{Q}_p$-linear map $y\mapsto xy$. As $R$ is a free $\mathbb{Z}_p$-module of rank $ef$, the reduction of $m_x$ modulo $p$ is the $\mathbb{F}_p$-linear map
$$\bar m_x:R/pR\longrightarrow R/pR,\qquad \bar y\mapsto \overline{xy},$$
on the $ef$-dimensional $\mathbb{F}_p$-vector space $R/pR=R/\mathfrak p^e$, and
$$N_{K/\mathbb{Q}_p}(x)\bmod p \;=\; \det(\bar m_x)\in\mathbb F_p.$$

**Filtration.** The ring $R/\mathfrak p^e$ carries the finite filtration
$$R/\mathfrak p^e \;\supset\; \mathfrak p/\mathfrak p^e \;\supset\; \mathfrak p^2/\mathfrak p^e \;\supset\;\cdots\;\supset\; \mathfrak p^{e-1}/\mathfrak p^e \;\supset\; 0.$$
Since $\mathfrak p=(\pi)$ is principal, multiplication by $\pi^i$ gives an $R/\mathfrak p$-module isomorphism
$$R/\mathfrak p \;\xrightarrow{\;\sim\;}\; \mathfrak p^i/\mathfrak p^{i+1},\qquad \bar a\mapsto \overline{\pi^i a},$$
so each graded piece $\mathfrak p^i/\mathfrak p^{i+1}$ is a one-dimensional $\mathbb F_{p^f}$-vector space (hence $f$-dimensional over $\mathbb F_p$). The total dimension over $\mathbb F_p$ is $ef$, as expected.

**Action on the graded pieces.** The map $\bar m_x$ preserves the filtration (because $x\in R$ implies $x\mathfrak p^i\subseteq\mathfrak p^i$). On the graded piece $\mathfrak p^i/\mathfrak p^{i+1}\cong R/\mathfrak p=\mathbb F_{p^f}$, the induced action is multiplication by $\bar x$ (the reduction of $x$ modulo $\mathfrak p$): indeed, for $y=\pi^i a\in\mathfrak p^i$,
$$xy=\pi^i(xa),\qquad xa\bmod\mathfrak p = \bar x\,\bar a,\qquad\text{so}\quad \overline{xy}\in\mathfrak p^i/\mathfrak p^{i+1}\;\leftrightarrow\;\bar x\,\bar a\in\mathbb F_{p^f}.$$

**Determinant.** Passing to the associated graded module converts $\bar m_x$ into a block-diagonal map with $e$ identical blocks, each equal to multiplication by $\bar x$ on $\mathbb F_{p^f}$ viewed as an $f$-dimensional $\mathbb F_p$-vector space. The determinant is invariant under passing to the associated graded (the filtration yields an upper-triangular block form), hence
$$\det(\bar m_x)=\prod_{i=0}^{e-1}\det\!\bigl(\text{mult. by }\bar x\text{ on }\mathbb F_{p^f}/\mathbb F_p\bigr).$$
The determinant of multiplication by $\bar x$ on $\mathbb F_{p^f}$ as an $\mathbb F_p$-linear map is by definition the field norm $N_{\mathbb F_{p^f}/\mathbb F_p}(\bar x)$. Therefore
$$N_{K/\mathbb{Q}_p}(x)\bmod p \;=\; \det(\bar m_x) \;=\; N_{\mathbb F_{p^f}/\mathbb F_p}(\bar x)^{e}.$$

This holds for every $x\in R$, so the mod-$\mathfrak p$ reduction of $N_{R/\mathbb Z_p}$ equals the $e^{\text{th}}$ power of $N_{\mathbb F_{p^f}/\mathbb F_p}$. $\blacksquare$
